skills.name: create-project
skills.description: Create a Kube-DC Project inside an existing Organization. Covers network selection, quota preflight, the Project manifest, and readiness verification.

skills.name: deploy-app
skills.description: Deploy a containerized application to a Kube-DC Project with optional persistent storage, a managed database, external exposure, or gated Shared GPU acceleration; set up keyless deploys, builds on push and pull request previews from a GitHub repository, with a managed container registry or the user's own.

skills.name: create-vm
skills.description: Create a KubeVirt virtual machine in a Kube-DC Project using the live OS catalog, Project networking, supported storage, and the generated SSH keypair.

skills.name: create-database
skills.description: Create a managed database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, ClickHouse) or Valkey cache in a Kube-DC Project as a ManagedService, deliver its credential to workloads with a ServiceBinding Secret, and prepare backup and restore workflows.

skills.name: expose-service
skills.description: Expose a Service from a Kube-DC Project with a hostname-based HTTP/HTTPS/TLS Gateway route or a dedicated EIP-backed LoadBalancer for selected TCP/UDP ports.

skills.name: manage-cluster
skills.description: "Operate a Kube-DC Managed Cluster: download its external kubeconfig, scale or autoscale worker pools, perform supported upgrades, and inspect status."

skills.name: manage-networking
skills.description: Manage Kube-DC Project networking with EIp and FIp resources, Service exposure, and Organization-authorized Routed Network attachments to approved external destinations.

skills.name: manage-storage
skills.description: Create ObjectBucketClaims for S3-compatible buckets, DataVolumes for VM disks, and PersistentVolumeClaims for Project workloads.

skills.name: manage-access
skills.description: Manage Kube-DC Organization Groups and Project RBAC. Use OrganizationGroup resources to give teams standard or custom roles in selected Projects; manage individual users in the console.

skills.name: ssh-into-vm
skills.description: Connect securely to a Kube-DC virtual machine through the browser, an approved private route, a Floating IP, or an EIP-bound LoadBalancer Service.

skills.name: use-kube-dc-cli
skills.description: Install and use the kube-dc CLI for Organization login, Project context switching, kubeconfig integration, and logout.

skills.name: check-quota
skills.description: Check Kube-DC Organization and Project quota before creating workloads, VMs, databases, Managed Clusters, public IPs, or storage.

skills.name: deploy-web-stack
skills.description: Deploy a complete web application in a Kube-DC Project — a managed database (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB) with delivered credentials, an optional persistent volume, and an HTTPS hostname with a platform certificate through the shared Gateway, without a public IP. Use for WordPress, CMSs, APIs and any app that needs a database and a URL.

skills.name: install-kube-dc
skills.description: Plan and install a new Kube-DC platform on prepared servers with the kube-dc CLI. Gathers the site facts, checks hosts, disks and DNS, proposes the network, front door, Ceph storage, domain and certificate design, then runs bootstrap install, init and accept. Operator skill; needs SSH access to the servers and a Git repository for the fleet.

skills.name: manage-certificates
skills.description: Request and manage a Project-scoped ManagedCertificate for private Organization PKI or public ACME issuance, then consume the resulting Kubernetes TLS Secret.

skills.name: manage-database-credentials
skills.description: Deliver a managed service credential role to a workload with a ServiceBinding Secret, rotate it now with a RotateCredentials operation, or rotate it on a schedule with a ServiceCredentialPolicy.

skills.name: manage-kms
skills.description: Create and operate Kube-DC KMSKey resources backed by non-exportable OpenBao Transit keys, use the authenticated CLI for short payloads, and design envelope encryption for larger data.

skills.name: manage-secrets
skills.description: Store Project application secrets in Kube-DC's managed secret service, optionally sync them into Kubernetes Secrets, and manage their lifecycle with the kube-dc CLI.
